Changelog

sportyR 2.4.2

Bug Fixes

  • lacrosse: end goal mouth stubs on the inner arc (#89) (1b13ebd), closes #87 #87

sportyR 2.4.1

Bug Fixes

  • make feature polygons simple closed rings (#79) (#85) (69e371b)

sportyR 2.4.0

New Functions

  • get_surface_dimensions(sport, league = NULL) returns the rule-book parameters the geom_*() functions draw from, for one league or every league of a sport, so other packages no longer need to read the internal surface_dimensions (#73)

Patches/Bug Fixes

  • geom_lacrosse(): the NLL and World Lacrosse neutral zones now span the 85 ft between the restraining lines; the zones read a key the data did not have, so the neutral zone was always 0 long (#60)
  • geom_lacrosse(): the NLL and World Lacrosse penalty box fills now start at the inside edge of the boards; their anchor read board_thickness instead of boards_thickness (#61)
  • geom_lacrosse(): the goal-fan hash marks (NCAA and USA Lacrosse women’s) are now placed at the angle they are rotated by, so each sits on the fan arc, perpendicular to it, at its stated distance along the arc; they were placed s / goal_fan_radius but rotated s / (goal_fan_radius + goal_circle_radius) radians from the centre mark (#62)
  • geom_lacrosse(): display_range = "full" (and the half-field ranges) now take in the NLL and World Lacrosse player benches, penalty boxes and off-field officials’ box, whose outer 0.5 ft was cut off by a range that stopped at the apron (#63)
  • geom_lacrosse(): goal_arc_line_thickness now defaults to 0 like every other feature argument; a goal arc added through field_updates without a thickness was drawn as a solid block (#64)
  • geom_lacrosse(): a center_face_off_marker colour passed in color_updates is kept; the contrasting default (#ffcb05, NCAA men’s) is applied only when the user did not choose a colour and the marker would match the centre line. This also means that recolouring only center_line now stops the yellow contrast default from applying: the marker keeps its default white (#65)
  • NCAA football: restricted_area_width is now 1.8889 yd, so the coaching line sits six feet outside the sideline (measured from its inside edge) and the limit line twelve feet out, per NCAA Football Rules 1-2-2, 1-2-3-a and 1-2-4-a; it was 1.3333 yd, which put the coaching line 4.33 ft out (#66)
  • geom_lacrosse(): the NCAA and USA Lacrosse women’s 8-meter arc now follows NCAA Women’s Lacrosse Rule 1, Sections 6-7: an arc of 10.6 m about the centre of the goal line, ending on 45-degree lines from where the goal line extended crosses the goal circle (it was a 13.2 m arc about a point behind the goal line). Its hash marks sit on that circle, the 12 m marks past the painted arc as in the rule book’s Diagram 2, and the two marks on the goal line extended are 30.5 cm long (were 0.4058 m). Leagues without a goal fan no longer draw a hidden, zero-size fan polygon (the picture is unchanged), and geom_lacrosse("custom") now draws instead of failing with “‘from’ must be a finite number” (#69)
  • geom_lacrosse(): the PLL two-point arc now follows the 2024 PLL Rulebook (II. The Field, G): its lines run parallel to the sidelines 13 yd from the centre of the goal line, from the end line until they are 15 yd from it, joined by a 15 yd arc; it was a 15 yd semicircle with its lines 15 yd out. New surface_dimensions key goal_arc_parallel_line_to_center (PLL: 13 yd); without it the arc stays a semicircle (#70)
  • NFL football: where the field border, its outline and the apron wrap round the trapezoid team bench, their outer corner now follows the bench’s slanted side (19.15 yd from centre, was 19.41 yd), as the 2026 NFL Rulebook’s bench-area diagram draws the line behind the bench parallel to it. The branch for slanted benches had been applied to rectangular ones and vice versa; NCAA, NFHS and CFL are unchanged (#71)
  • geom_lacrosse(): each NLL and World Lacrosse penalty box is now penalty_box_length (8 ft) inside, its outer wall moved out by one wall thickness (0.25 ft); it was 7.75 ft inside. The 24 ft of NLL Rule 8.1 is read as the sum of the three interiors (two penalty boxes and the officials’ box), as for the benches (#72)
  • geom_baseball(), geom_basketball(), geom_curling(), geom_football(), geom_hockey(), geom_lacrosse(), geom_soccer(), geom_tennis() and geom_volleyball(): drawing in other units (field_units, court_units, rink_units, pitch_units, sheet_units) now scales the features’ positions (including the football yardage numbers) and the display range along with their shapes. Before, the shapes were converted but placed with unconverted anchors, and the plot limits stayed in the rule book’s units. x_trans, y_trans, xlims and ylims are in the requested units, as before (geom_softball() already handled this) (#74)
  • geom_lacrosse(): the women’s 8-meter-arc hash marks are now centred on the middle of the arc’s line (goal_fan_radius - goal_fan_line_thickness / 2), so they bisect it as NCAA Women’s Lacrosse Rule 1, Section 7 requires; they straddled the line’s outer edge (#75)
  • geom_football(): the invisible bounding box drawn with each yardage number is no longer translated twice by x_trans / y_trans; it moved by double the translation, away from its number (#76)
  • Drawing a custom surface in other units (e.g. geom_lacrosse("custom", field_units = "m")) now explains that custom surfaces have no rule-book units and how to set them, instead of failing with “’ is not a viable unit at this time.’”
  • geom_basketball("custom") now draws: the custom template’s empty JSON arrays arrive as list(), which %or% could not handle (it now falls back to the default for any zero-length value) and which the lane and display-range code read directly (#77)
  • The geom_lacrosse() example now uses a lacrosse league ("NLL") instead of the volleyball league "FIVB"

Changed output

  • football: field_bordered is now read; NCAA, NFHS and NFL draw a white border outline by default; CFL is unchanged. field_bordered is now true for NCAA, NFHS (11/9/8/6) and NFL, and bordered fields default field_border_outline and red_zone_border_outline to #ffffff (otherwise transparent #ffffff00); a colour passed in color_updates always wins (#67)

Other Changes

  • Added a package citation (citation("sportyR")) and a softball example to the introductory vignette
  • Fixed redirecting and broken URLs in the vignette and README
  • Documentation regenerated with roxygen2 8.1.0
  • Every test file now starts with skip_on_cran()

Features

  • lacrosse and football geometry fixes, unit scaling, get_surface_dimensions() (#60-#77) (#68) (fb7ffe5), closes #61 #62 #63 #64 #65 #66 #67 #67 #65 #69 #70 #71 #72 70/#71 #73 #74 #75 #74 #76 #74 #74

sportyR 2.2.0

Patches/Bug Fixes

  • Fixed #24. Invalid league errors should now be more explicit

Changes to Existing Sports

  • MLB and MiLB bases are now 18” by default per the 2023 rules change

New Sports and Leagues Supported

Lacrosse

  • National Lacrosse League
  • NCAA Men’s Lacrosse
  • NCAA Women’s Lacrosse
  • Premier Lacrosse League
  • USA Men’s Lacrosse
  • USA Women’s Lacrosse
  • World Lacrosse

Internal Changes

  • Re-aligned switch() statements to have condition and cases with matching indentation to improve readability

  • Updated syntax in geom_football() to avoid tidy syntax deprecation warning

  • Added load_default_parameters() function for faster debugging internally. This function allows all defaults of a particular geom_{sport}() function to be loaded and set as environment variables rather than having to set each one individually

  • Updated data-raw/internal-datasets.R to clear environment and reload current version of package upon sourcing for debugging

sportyR 2.1.0

CRAN release: 2022-10-31

Patches/Bug Fixes

  • Fixed #14. Issue with volleyball documentation

  • Fixed #15. All outline colors are respected

  • Added red zone border and border outline to football fields

  • Changed default coloring of football field border outline

  • Fixed issue with field border thickness when plotting behind the bench

  • Fixed #18. Can now constrain all plots to only display in-bound playing area (plus sidelines)

  • Corrected football field layering to work better with hex-alpha color specifications (layering of colors previously caused issues)

Internal Changes

  • Renamed files to use - (hyphen) instead of _ (underscore) across package

  • New function, is_hex(), checks if a value is valid hexadecimal (relates to #15)

  • Animating Tracking Data vignette now uses images hosted on GitHub to avoid the need to render at run time

New Sports and Leagues Supported

Volleyball

  • FIVB
  • NCAA
  • USA Volleyball

Curling

  • Curling Canada

sportyR 2.0.1

CRAN release: 2022-09-24

Patches/Bug Fixes

  • Fixed #8. All display ranges for hockey rinks work as expected

  • Fixed #9. Yardage markers now move responsive to x_trans and y_trans

  • Added gifski package as Suggests-level dependency so gifs in vignettes may render properly

Intenal Changes

  • Changed logic into how curling ends are drawn/placed on a curling sheet

  • Adjusted xlims for geom_hockey() to include slightly more of the neutral zone when using display_range %in% c("ozone", "dzone")

  • Updated licensing to GPL >= 3

  • Changed website colors

sportyR 2.0.0

CRAN release: 2022-08-15

Internal Changes

  • Re-defined all surfaces to be parameterized by the size of their features, rather than being defined individually in a file

  • New internal data set (data-raw/surface_dimensions.json) to maintain all league dimensions

  • Removal of data-raw/sport_lookup.json and data-raw/league_lookup.json files (replaced by data-raw/surface_dimensions.json)

  • Updated styling conventions to match tidyverse style guide with the sole exception being the use of explicit return() statements

  • Updated file naming convention to be easier to group feature files and geom_{sport}() files

  • Updated documentation

Additional Capabilities

  • Introduction of the display_range parameter to allow customized views of plots (e.g. only seeing the red zone of a football field, rather than the entire field)

  • Introduction of the {surface}_updates parameter to allow customization of a surface starting at a base surface (e.g. geom_hockey("NHL", surface_updates = list(rink_length = 400))) will create a regulation NHL ice rink that is twice as long as it should be. This allows the package to better handle edge cases and support more users off the bat with less internal maintenance

  • Introduction of the color_updates parameter to allow colors of features to change more easily and explicitly internally in the code

  • Introduction of x_trans and y_trans argument for every surface to adjust positioning of origin

New Sports and Leagues Supported

Baseball

  • MiLB
  • Little League
  • NCAA
  • NFHS (high school)
  • Pony

Basketball

  • NBA G League
  • NFHS (high school)

Curling (New Supported Sport)

  • WCF (World Curling Federation)

Hockey

  • AHL
  • ECHL
  • OHL
  • QMJHL
  • USHL

Football

  • NFHS 11-player
  • NFHS 9-player
  • NFHS 8-player
  • NFHS 6-player

Tennis

  • ATP
  • ITA
  • USTA
  • WTA

Breaking Changes (and justifications for breaks)

  • Removed full_surf and rotation_dir arguments to allow for display_range and more flexible rotation arguments to be introduced. The improved argument structure will allow for more granular “zoom” on plots to regions of interest, as well as adjusting coordinates appropriately to match data sets

  • Removed vdiffr tests as these were becoming unmanageable and didn’t scale well to new leagues. Additionally, should a league change its dimension requirements, the case itself is no longer valid despite the league’s plot requiring the change. Instead, the individual plotting functions are checked as well as the classes of the resulting plots

sportyR 1.0.4

  • Removed requirement to include a plot caption color (fixes #3)

  • On September 7, 2021, the NWHL changed names to be the PHF. This name change is now reflected in the package, with NWHL still valid so as to be backwards compatible.

sportyR 1.0.3

  • Added tennis plotting capability
  • Fixed issue with NCAA football plot hash marks (initially typed as 6, should have been typed as 60)
  • Fixed minor bug with all soccer plots (changed rotation_dir = TRUE to rotation_dir = "ccw")
  • Fixed minor bug in NCAA hockey plots when plotting in units other than ft (reordered geom_ncaa_hockey() code to adjust units before plotting)
  • Restructured code in tests/testthat/test-plot-functions.R to more closely resemble rest of repository structure. Plots now tested by sport rather than by plot-specific feature (e.g. units or rotation)
  • Fixed minor bug with converting between millimeters and feet (originally was specified as 3048mm per foot, corrected to 304.8mm per foot)

sportyR 1.0.2

  • Added CFL plotting capability

sportyR 1.0.1

CRAN release: 2021-04-20

  • Introduced new testing infrastructure

sportyR 1.0.0

CRAN release: 2021-04-19

Initial release! Ability to plot baseball, basketball ((W)NBA, NCAA, and FIBA), football (NFL and NCAA), hockey ((W)NHL, IIHF, NCAA), and soccer (FIFA, MLS, NCAA, NWSL, and Premier League) is included, with the capability to customize outputs in specific colors.
